title: NYC pied-à-terre tax rollout can proceed, appeals court rules
summary: The decision reversed a lower court's ruling that the initial notices sent to homeowners were flawed.

title: Voters’ data center backlash puts cities in the spotlight, experts say
summary: Overwhelming voter opposition could spur new state-level regulations and push local officials to demand more from data center developers on infrastructure, utilities and community impacts.

title: AI-powered assistance moves into physical spaces with AI City product
summary: The kiosks offer personalized guidance and real-time assistance in on-site, a tech company says. In Santa Clara County, California, a mayor’s hologram is giving the answers.

title: The best US cities for bike, pedestrian travel: Streetlight Data
summary: The report analyzed bicycle and pedestrian miles traveled in 100 U.S. cities. It found that walking accounted for seven times more miles annually than biking.

title: 5 factors shaping the most prosperous US cities
summary: Population renewal, climate resilience, social cohesion, technology readiness and long-term governance are critical to a region’s success, according to the Geography of Prosperity Index.

title: These 6 US cities are demonstrating AI leadership: ThoughtLab
summary: Data management, infrastructure management and cybersecurity were among the top applications for AI in cities, the survey found.

title: Central Park stormwater project to reduce flood risk in NYC’s Harlem, East Harlem
summary: A $35.7M recirculation system is expected to capture stormwater, reduce sewer flows by 90% and save 175 million gallons of potable water annually.

title: California High-Speed Rail Authority CEO steps down
summary: CEO Ian Choudri's departure becomes another challenge for the California High-Speed Rail Authority amid uncertain funding and a new governor set to take office next year.

title: Website upgrade lets users explore 50 years of Los Angeles records
summary: Users can seamlessly track legislative items and follow City Council meetings and agendas on the Los Angeles Office of the City Clerk site, the office says.

title: FEMA commits $1.3B to disaster recovery, resilience
summary: The Federal Emergency Management Agency is offering $400 million to reduce flooding and awarded nearly $900 million in recovery and mitigation grants as it shifts responsibility to local governments.
